_comment: Soybean calibrated on the bucket-discharge bench tests (README.md, issue #16). Fit on runs 1 and 4, tested on runs 3 and 2, all with the reference preset. 'material' is a dem_scenario.Material, 'clump' the multi-sphere grain shape (granular_clumps.py / dem_clumps.py), and 'parts' the Coulomb friction for each surface.

sphere_fallback._comment: Best single-sphere settings (no clumps). They cannot fit both fill levels: rolling friction 0.17 leaves 577 g / 632 g in runs 1 / 4, and the flow creeps on after the real flow stops.

not_identified: steel wall friction (0.3 vs 0.5: no effect)
